newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Sino Land new issue to raise HK$2.12 bln.
newsitem.headline: Sino Land new issue to raise HK$2.12 bln.

text.p: Sino Land Co Ltd said its issue of 238 million new shares to controlling shareholder Tsim Sha Tsui Properties Ltd would raise a net HK$2.12 billion to fund the purchase and development of properties in Hong Kong.

The companies said in a joint statement that Sino Land would use the proceeds to fund projects including the Tai Kok Tsui MTR Station Site B in Kowloon, and developments in North Point, Repulse Bay and Yuen Long.

Sino Land said Tsim Sha Tsui Properteris had agreed to privately place 238 million Sino Land shares at HK$9.13 per share before buying the same amount of new shares at a price equal to the new price per share after deducting expenses.
The placing is expected to be completed on December 30.
On completion of the placing and subscription, Tsim Sha Tsui Properties' stake in Sino Land will be reduced to 56.5 percent from 61.3 percent.
Shares of Sino Land fell HK$0.40 to HK$9.20 each in mid morning while Tsim Sha Tsui Properties shares edged up HK$0.10 to HK$15.00.
